acquisition_method.evidence: The Exploris was run in data-independent acquisition mode with an MS1 scan from 399 to 1001 m/z in 60k resolution followed by 50 MS2 scans of 12 m/z each, covering the full range from 400 to 1000 m/z with a resolution of 22.5k and 1000% AGC target

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Afterwards, samples were diluted down to 2 M Urea and digested with Trypsin (Serva, ratio 1:75). Finally, samples were acidified using formic acid (Honeywell) and loaded onto SDB-RPS Stage Tips for desalting and washing.
